_note: Curated DSA sheets. items[].slug must exist in dsa-problems.json. NeetCode lists come from github.com/neetcode-gh/leetcode (.problemSiteData.json); Striver SDE from the takeuforward sheet (LeetCode-hosted questions only). Premium-only problems are omitted (see `omitted`). Videos are YouTube links.

sheets.name: Blind 75
sheets.description: The classic 75 questions, in NeetCode's topic order, each with a video walkthrough.

sheets.name: NeetCode 150
sheets.description: Blind 75 plus 75 more, grouped by pattern, with video explanations.

sheets.name: NeetCode All
sheets.description: Every problem on NeetCode's full list (about 450), grouped by pattern, with video explanations. The JavaScript-only items are on the JavaScript tab.

sheets.name: Striver SDE Sheet
sheets.description: Striver's 30-day SDE sheet, LeetCode-hosted problems only (about two thirds of the original 191; the rest live on GeeksforGeeks and other judges). Videos are from the takeuforward playlist.
